items.title: 12.4.2 Anthropogenic (man-made) sources (insanon ke banaye hue zaraye) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.4.2, printed page 277.

blocks.text: NOₓ ke sab se bare human (anthropogenic) sources (zaraye) gariyon aur power plants mein fossil fuels (petrol, diesel, koyla, gas) ka jalna hain. Doosre sources chemical plants, biomass (lakri, fasal ki remains yani baqiyat) ka jalna aur welding waghera hain.

blocks.caption: NOₓ ke human sources
rows: crop (fasal) ki remains aur lakri ki aag

blocks.prompt: NOₓ ka sab se bara human zariya kaun sa hai, aur ise kaise kam kiya ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Gariyon aur power plants mein fossil fuels ka jalna. Gariyon mein three-way catalytic converter (12.6) NO ko N₂ mein badal deta hai; power plants apni flue gases ko catalyst se saaf karte hain.

items: Human NOₓ: gariyon aur power plants mein fossil fuel ka jalna (sab se bara), chemical plants, biomass ka jalna, welding.
